shortDescription: Resource module for Security Rogue Additional Details

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: This is the epoch end time in milliseconds upto which data need to be fetched. Default value is current time.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value is 1000.

options.name: offset
options.description: The offset of the first item in the collection to return. Default value is 1.

options.name: siteId
options.description: Filter Rogues by location. Site IDs information can be fetched from "Get Site" API.

options.name: startTime
options.description: This is the epoch start time in milliseconds from which data need to be fetched. Default value is 24 hours earlier to endTime.

options.name: threatLevel
options.description: Filter Rogues by Threat Level. Threat Level information can be fetched from "Get Threat Levels" API.

options.name: threatType
options.description: Filter Rogues by Threat Type. Threat Type information can be fetched from "Get Threat Types" API.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
